questions.stem: What is the term used for the sequence of events by which a cell duplicates its genome and divides into two daughter cells?
questions.solution: The term used for the sequence of events by which a cell duplicates its genome and divides into two daughter cells is the cell cycle. This includes all the stages a cell goes through, from growth to division. Mitosis refers only to the division of the nucleus, meiosis is a specialized type of cell division for gametes, and cell division is a general term that does not specifically describe the entire sequence.

questions.stem: Which phase of the cell cycle is the longest?
questions.solution: Interphase is the longest phase of the cell cycle because it includes the G1, S, and G2 phases, which together take up the majority of the time. The G1, S, and G2 phases are all shorter individually and are part of the larger interphase period. The other options are subphases of interphase and not the longest phase on their own.

questions.stem: Which phase of the cell cycle is marked by DNA replication and chromosome duplication?
questions.solution: DNA replication and chromosome duplication occur during the S phase, which is part of interphase. Interphase is the phase where the cell grows and prepares for division, while mitosis, cytokinesis, and karyokinesis are stages of cell division itself. Therefore, the correct answer is Interphase.

questions.stem: If a cell is in the G phase of the cell cycle, what is it likely doing?
choices: Growing and carrying out normal metabolism
Aligning chromosomes at the equatorial plate
questions.solution: The G phase is the period when the cell grows and performs its normal functions, such as protein synthesis and organelle replication. DNA replication occurs during the S phase, not the G phase. Chromosome condensation and alignment happen during mitosis, not the G phase. Therefore, the correct answer is growing and carrying out normal metabolism.

questions.stem: If a cell is observed to have its chromosomes aligned at the metaphase plate, which of the following is most likely to occur next?
choices: The nuclear envelope reforms around the chromosomes.
The sister chromatids separate and move to opposite poles.
The cell divides into two daughter cells.
The chromosomes condense and become visible.
questions.solution: The correct answer is that the sister chromatids separate and move to opposite poles. After metaphase, the cell proceeds to anaphase, where the sister chromatids split and are pulled to opposite poles. The nuclear envelope reforms during telophase, cell division occurs during cytokinesis, and chromosome condensation occurs during prophase.

questions.stem: If a cell has 2C DNA content at G1 phase, what will be the DNA content after S phase and after M phase, respectively?
questions.solution: The DNA content doubles during S phase, so it becomes 4C. After M phase, the DNA content is halved in each daughter cell, so it returns to 2C. Therefore, the correct answer is 4C, 2C. The option 2C, 2C is wrong because DNA content doubles during S phase. The option 2C, 4C is wrong because DNA content does not double after M phase. The option 4C, 4C is wrong because DNA content is halved after M phase.

questions.stem: If a cell in G phase is prevented from entering the S phase, what would be the effect on the cell cycle?
choices: The cell would not replicate its DNA.
The cell would undergo mitosis without DNA replication.
The cell would enter the G phase directly.
The cell would stop dividing permanently.
questions.solution: The correct answer is The cell would not replicate its DNA. The S phase is responsible for DNA replication. If the cell is prevented from entering S phase, DNA replication does not occur. The other options misinterpret the role of the G phase in the cell cycle.

hi.stem: यदि G चरण में एक कोशिका S चरण में प्रवेश से रोक दी जाए, तो कोशिका चक्र पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
choices: कोशिका अपना डीएनए प्रतिकृति नहीं बनाएगा।
कोशिका डीएनए प्रतिकृति के बिना मिटोसिस करेगी।
कोशिका सीधे G चरण में प्रवेश कर जाएगी।
कोशिका स्थायी रूप से विभाजित नहीं होगी।
hi.solution: सही उत्तर कोशिका अपना डीएनए प्रतिकृति नहीं बनाएगा। S चरण डीएनए प्रतिकृति के लिए उत्तरदायी होता है। यदि कोशिका S चरण में प्रवेश से रोक दी जाए, तो डीएनए प्रतिकृति नहीं होती है। अन्य विकल्प कोशिका चक्र में G चरण के कार्य को गलत तरीके से समझते हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology used in Hindi textbooks.

mr.stem: ग फेजमधील एक कोशिका S फेजमध्ये प्रवेश करू शकत नाही, तर कोशिका चक्रावर काय परिणाम होईल?
choices: कोशिका आपले डीएनए प्रतिकृत करणार नाही.
कोशिका सी फेजमध्ये लगेच प्रवेश करेल.
कोशिका अशाप्रकारे विभाजित होणे बंद करेल.
mr.solution: योग्य उत्तर कोशिका आपले डीएनए प्रतिकृत करणार नाही. S फेज डीएनए प्रतिकृतीसाठी जबाबदार आहे. जर कोशिका S फेजमध्ये प्रवेश करू शकत नसेल तर डीएनए प्रतिकृती होणार नाही. इतर विकल्प कोशिका चक्रातील G फेजच्या भूमिकेचे चुकीचे अर्थ समजतात.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi biological terminology.

questions.stem: Which of the following best explains the significance of meiosis in sexual reproduction?
choices: It ensures the production of identical daughter cells
It maintains the chromosome number in the offspring
It reduces the chromosome number to half in gametes
It allows for the formation of body cells
questions.solution: Meiosis reduces the chromosome number by half in gametes, ensuring that when they combine during fertilization, the offspring has the correct number of chromosomes. The other options are incorrect because meiosis does not produce identical cells, does not maintain chromosome number in gametes, and does not form body cells.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा यौन प्रजनन में मेयोसिस के महत्व की सबसे अच्छी व्याख्या करता है?
choices: यह संतति को समान डॉटर सेल के उत्पादन की गारंटी देता है
यह संतति में गुणसूत्र संख्या को बरकरार रखता है
यह युग्मकों में गुणसूत्र संख्या को आधा कर देता है
यह शरीर कोशिकाओं के निर्माण की अनुमति देता है
hi.solution: मेयोसिस युग्मकों में गुणसूत्र संख्या को आधा कर देता है, जिससे निषेचन के दौरान संतति में सही गुणसूत्र संख्या होती है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि मेयोसिस समान कोशिकाओं के उत्पादन नहीं करता है, युग्मकों में गुणसूत्र संख्या को बरकरार नहीं रखता है और शरीर कोशिकाओं के निर्माण में सहायता नहीं करता है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology and meaning of the original question.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते योग्यरित्या लैंगिक प्रजोत्पादनातील मियोसिसच्या महत्त्वाचे स्पष्टीकरण करते?
choices: ते समान दुहेरी कोशिका तयार करण्याची खात्री देते
ते वंशात गुणसूत्रांच्या संख्येचे नियमन करते
ते गॅमिट्समध्ये गुणसूत्रांच्या संख्येला अर्ध्यापर्यंत कमी करते
ते शरीर कोशिकांच्या निर्मितीसाठी परवानगी देते
mr.solution: मियोसिस गॅमिट्समध्ये गुणसूत्रांच्या संख्येला अर्ध्यापर्यंत कमी करते, जेणेकरून निर्मिती दरम्यान त्यांच्या जोडणीमुळे वंशात योग्य गुणसूत्रांची संख्या असते. इतर विकल्प अयोग्य आहेत कारण मियोसिस समान कोशिका तयार करत नाही, गॅमिट्समध्ये गुणसूत्रांच्या संख्येचे नियमन करत नाही आणि शरीर कोशिका तयार करत नाही.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology appropriate for a Marathi-medium textbook.
